revised_prompt: Generate an image following the dimensions of 1200x630 pixels (1.91:1 ratio). At the center of the image, place a large, circular, glowing logo, with colors purple (#8b5cf6) and teal (#10b981). Towards the top, overlay the text 'Good Flippin Design', representing the company's name. Below the logo, towards the bottom, add the tagline, 'Strategic Web Development'. The background should be dark with a subtle gradient, transitioning from dark charcoal (#0d0d0d) to slightly lighter charcoal (#1a1a1a). The text should be written in clean white (#f5f5f5). The composition must be balanced and symmetrical, creating a professional social card. The image should be designed to be recognizable at a smaller scale, such as on Facebook or LinkedIn thumbnails, ensuring the logo, brand name, and tagline are all clear and visible. Text should distance itself from extreme edges to avoid cropping. Overall, aim for a professional, polished aesthetic that works well on both light and dark social feeds.
